triples.evidence_text: Hydraulic lock may occur where a piping system is arranged such that malfunctions (for example, in directional valves or in the valve control) can cause power units to work in a closed circuit against each other rather than in parallel delivering fluid to the rudder actuator, thus resulting in loss of steering.
